skills.name: Twin Fans: Ukifune
skills.description:
Hirara wields Kaerazu (Skill 1) and Meisen-e (Skill 2). Drag one skill onto the other to cast a Combo Skill. Hirara has 4 stacks of Crimson / Death Energy. Casting Skill 1 or 2 consumes 1 Crimson / Death Energy, while casting a Combo Skill consumes 2. Her Energy fully recovers after 4s (casting skills interrupts the recovery).

Skills cast with Kaerazu and Meisen-e apply Crimson and Death marks to non-minion enemies, respectively. Enemies marked with both are immobilized for 0.8s (Cooldown: 3s).

Hirara does not benefit from Cooldown Reduction. Instead, it reduces the energy recovery time of Crimson / Death.

skills.name: Kaerazu
skills.description:
Hirara uses Kaerazu to sweep a fan-shaped area, dealing 275 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Skills cast with Kaerazu will deal damage again at the target location after a delay, dealing 2 time(s) the original damage.

skills.name: Meisen-e
skills.description:
Hirara uses the power of Meisen-e to dance in the Sanzu, dashing in the target direction and dealing 275 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. She can dash again after the first dash. At the end of the dash, she unleashes a water wave forward, dealing 275 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Skills cast with Meisen-e have two dashes.

skills.name: Forbidden Jutsu: Momijigari
skills.description: Hirara releases the seal on Twin Fans: Ukifune, gaining a burst of Movement Speed that decays over 1s. Her max Crimson / Death Energy increases to 6 for 10s. Each kill or assist during this period extends the duration by 4s.
